description: Capability for the licence windows (I-443): one window per licence file, labelled licence-licence and licence-notices, which the pattern below covers. A second window starts with NOTHING granted (see settings.json for what that looked like on the rig), and this page needs exactly one permission: showing itself once it has painted, since the window is created hidden. It reads the file through UP-TAKE's own licence_text command, not through any file-system permission.
